notes: Two-player Pong in LÖVE: left paddle WASD (F to slow), right paddle numpad 8/5 (kp4 to slow); ball bounces off paddles and walls; scoring when the ball passes a side, then the rally resets. CLEAN: GPL-2.0; paddles/ball drawn with love.graphics primitives; scores use the default font via love.graphics.print; no bundled TTF/OTF/audio/images; no EXE/DLL/LFS. ~60K. Claim #3908.
